global_font_screen.title: Fonts
global_font_screen.status_cached_missing: Cached font missing - using JetBrains Mono
global_font_screen.catalog_load_failed: Font catalog could not be loaded
global_font_screen.fontsource_unavailable: Fontsource is unavailable and no cached catalog exists
global_font_screen.unsafe_url: Fontsource returned an unsafe download URL
global_font_screen.unsupported_font_file: This is not a supported TrueType or OpenType font
global_font_screen.atlas_restore_failed: font atlas could not be restored
global_font_screen.atlas_rebuild_failed: font atlas could not be rebuilt
global_font_screen.default_not_ready: Minecraft's default font is not ready
global_font_screen.host_not_ready: The Minecraft font host is not ready

category.empty: No features in this category yet.

menu.export_done: The settings of %s are on your clipboard.

screenshots.name: Screenshots
screenshots.desc: Shows a preview with quick actions when you take a screenshot, instead of a chat line.

uitheme.name: Theme
uitheme.desc: Colors the BlackAddons interface. Pick one of ours, change it, or import one.

theme.name: Theme
theme.desc: Pick a theme, change its colors, or bring one in from the clipboard.
theme.label: Open

menu_blur.name: Menu Blur
menu_blur.desc: Blur the world behind BlackAddons menus. Off leaves it sharp.

hotbarkeybinds.name: Hotbar Keybinds
hotbarkeybinds.desc: Bind extra keys or mouse buttons to hotbar slots, on top of the vanilla ones.

hold_to_return.name: Hold To Return
hold_to_return.desc: Hold the bind to bring the slot up, release to go back to the previous one.

modlisthider.name: Modlist Hider
modlisthider.desc: Hide your installed mods from the server.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc:
Hypixel = hide everything except Hypixel's own Mod API.
Vanilla = hide that too.
Custom = reveal only what you allow below.
mode.unsafe: Vanilla drops Hypixel's Mod API handshake along with everything else, so the server never tells the client which island it is on. Every mod built on that — SkyHanni, Nebula, ours — goes quiet without an error. Use Hypixel unless you need total silence.

disable_custom_payloads.name: Disable Custom Payloads
disable_custom_payloads.desc: Strip channels missing from the allowlist out of register/unregister packets.

allowed_channels.name: Allowed Channels
allowed_channels.desc: Channels that survive payload filtering in Custom mode.

choose_mods.name: Allowed Mods
choose_mods.desc: Tick the mods the server may see, chosen from the ones you actually have installed.
choose_mods.label: Open

custom_brand.name: Custom Brand
custom_brand.desc: Brand string sent to the server in Custom mode.

sign_anvil_guard.name: Sign & Anvil Guard
sign_anvil_guard.desc: Prevent servers from discovering installed mods via manipulated translation components in signs or anvils.

windowtitle.name: Window Title
windowtitle.desc: Shows BlackAddons in the window title.

format.name: Format
format.desc: {mod} is BlackAddons and its version, {mc} is Minecraft and its version. Empty = vanilla title.

windowicon.name: Window Icon
windowicon.desc: Shows the BlackAddons logo as the window and taskbar icon.

small_icon.name: Small Icon
small_icon.desc: The taskbar and title bar logo. The full logo is too detailed to read at that size.

discordpresence.name: Discord Presence
discordpresence.desc: Shows what you are doing in Minecraft on your Discord profile.

show_location.name: Show Location
show_location.desc: Hypixel, the SkyBlock area and the dungeon floor. Off = only singleplayer or multiplayer.

show_party.name: Show Party
show_party.desc: Party size and your class in dungeons.

show_timer.name: Show Timer
show_timer.desc: Time since you entered the area or the dungeon run started.

show_buttons.name: Show Buttons
show_buttons.desc: Links to BlackAddons and its Discord on your profile. Only others see them, Discord hides them from you.

border.name: Border
border.desc: Draw a 1px outline around the box.

corner_radius.name: Corner Radius
corner_radius.desc: Round the panel corners. 0 keeps them square.

fontsettings.name: Fonts
fontsettings.desc: Fonts for Minecraft's own text, the BlackAddons HUD and text drawn in the world.

configure.name: Font and Style
configure.desc: Choose and preview the Minecraft, HUD and world fonts and how each is drawn.
configure.label: Open

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.desc: Short notices in a corner of the screen - copied, saved, the servers are down.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: How long a notice stays on screen. Longer notices already stay longer on their own.

scaling.name: Scaling
scaling.desc: How large the BlackAddons interface and HUD are drawn.

auto_scale.name: Auto Scale
auto_scale.desc: Keep the interface and the HUD at the same share of the screen whatever its size, so resizing the window no longer changes what the HUD covers. The HUD then stops following Minecraft's GUI Scale — raising that makes the hotbar bigger and leaves this alone. Turn it off to size everything exactly the way Minecraft does.

interface_scale.name: Interface Scale
interface_scale.desc: Multiplier for every BlackAddons screen — the ClickGUI, the chat window, the profile viewer.

hud_scale.name: HUD Scale
hud_scale.desc: Multiplier for every HUD element, on top of the size each one is set to in the HUD editor.

actions.name: Actions
actions.desc: Settings and options for actions and waypoint rendering.

beacon_speed.name: Beacon Speed
beacon_speed.desc: How fast the beacon beam rotates around its axis. 0 stops it.

depth_check.name: Depth Check
depth_check.desc: Enable depth testing for waypoint rendering (hides waypoints behind blocks when enabled).

default_view.name: Default View
default_view.desc: Which view /b ac and the Actions tab open: the list, or the node graph.

tick_debugger.name: Tick Debugger
tick_debugger.desc: Show server ticks since the F7 phase started and until each tick-delayed location action fires.

connection.name: Connection
connection.desc: How the mod talks to the backend.

restart_live_updates.name: Restart Live Updates
restart_live_updates.desc: Drop the live-updates connection and open it again right away. The same as /blackaddons net socket.
restart_live_updates.label: Restart

restart_networking.name: Restart Networking
restart_networking.desc: Start everything the mod uses to reach the server over: connections, sign-in and the live-updates connection. For when nothing reconnects on its own. The same as /blackaddons net restart.
restart_networking.label: Restart

live_updates.name: Live Updates
live_updates.desc: Keep a connection open so cosmetics and notices arrive the moment they change, and count you among the players online. Off, the mod refreshes on a timer instead and reports nothing.

online_markers.name: Online Markers
online_markers.desc: Show a dot beside players who are online in BlackAddons right now. Nobody is marked as absent — a player with live updates turned off simply isn't connected.

fme.name: Legit FME
fme.desc: Replace how blocks look without changing the world.

edit_mode.name: Edit Mode
edit_mode.desc: Right-click replaces and left-click restores the block you are looking at.

preserve_block_shape.name: Preserve Block Shape
preserve_block_shape.desc: Keep the original block's visible shape while applying the replacement texture.

open_editor.name: Open Editor
open_editor.desc: Open the block appearance editor, even while FME is disabled.

toggle_edit_mode.name: Toggle Edit Mode
toggle_edit_mode.desc: Turn Edit Mode on or off.

toggle_any_block.name: Toggle Any Block
toggle_any_block.desc: In Edit Mode, switch between replacing only the clicked block type and any block at that position.

pick_block.name: Pick Block
pick_block.desc: In Edit Mode, select the block you are looking at.

place_ghost_block.name: Place Ghost Block
place_ghost_block.desc: In Edit Mode, place a visual block against the face you are looking at.

undo.name: Undo
undo.desc: In Edit Mode, take back the last FME edit.

redo.name: Redo
redo.desc: In Edit Mode, reapply the last undone FME edit.

playersize.name: Player Size
playersize.desc: Resize your own model. 1 is normal, 0 flattens an axis, a negative height turns you upside down.

customnickname.name: Custom Nickname
customnickname.desc: Show yourself a custom name over your head and in the tab list.

name.name: Name
name.desc: The name to display for yourself. Empty keeps your real name.

color.name: Color
color.desc: Color of the custom name. Enable Chroma for a rotating rainbow.

cosmetics.name: Cosmetics
cosmetics.desc: Show server cosmetics (custom names and sizes) for players who own them.

showothers.name: Show Other Players
showothers.desc: When off, only your own server cosmetic is applied — other players stay vanilla.

chinahat.name: China Hat
chinahat.desc: Renders a beautiful rotating rainbow China Hat on your head. This hat doesn't know what happened on Tiananmen Square in 1989.

height_offset.name: Height Offset
height_offset.desc: Additional height offset for the hat relative to the player's head.

color.name: Color
color.desc: Color of the hat. Enable Chroma for a rotating rainbow.

peak_height.name: Peak Height
peak_height.desc: How tall/pointy the China Hat is.

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: Radius (width) of the China Hat in blocks.

blackaddonschat.name: BlackAddons Chat
blackaddonschat.desc: The BlackAddons chat: a prefix in the game chat, and a window for the rest.

chat_prefix.name: Chat Prefix
chat_prefix.desc: Type this in front of a message in the game chat to say it in BlackAddons global instead. Double it to send a message that really starts with it. Empty turns it off.

game_chat_tag.name: Game Chat Tag
game_chat_tag.desc: Shown in front of BlackAddons chat lines in the game chat. Click it to open the chat window.

open_chat.name: Open Chat
open_chat.desc: Opens the chat window. Also on /blackaddons chat.

show_in_game_chat.name: Show In Game Chat
show_in_game_chat.desc: Echo new lines into the game chat while the window is closed, so a conversation is visible without opening anything.

image_preview.name: Image Preview
image_preview.desc: Hover a BlackAddons line in the game chat to see the picture it links to. Minecraft's own hover cannot hold an image, so this is drawn over the chat.

presence.name: Presence
presence.desc: Report that you're online for active-player stats. Off opts out.

screenqol.name: Screen QoL
screenqol.desc: Quality of life adjustments for screen overlays, status effects, and system toasts.

remove_fire_overlay.name: Remove Fire Overlay
remove_fire_overlay.desc: Removes the fiery screen overlay when your player is on fire.

hide_status_effects.name: Hide Status Effects
hide_status_effects.desc: Hides status potion effect icons on HUD and in inventory screens.

disable_night_vision.name: Disable Night Vision
disable_night_vision.desc: Renders the world as if you didn't have the Night Vision effect. Client-side only.

disable_tutorial_toasts.name: Disable Tutorial Toasts
disable_tutorial_toasts.desc: Suppresses Minecraft tutorial toasts from popping up.

disable_unsecure_chat_toast.name: Disable Unsecure Chat Toast
disable_unsecure_chat_toast.desc: Suppresses the unverified or unsecure chat toast warning on multiplayer servers.

disable_command_confirmation.name: Disable Command Confirmation
disable_command_confirmation.desc: Suppresses the confirmation prompt when clicking a command in chat.

disable_link_confirmation.name: Disable Link Confirmation
disable_link_confirmation.desc: Suppresses the confirmation prompt when clicking a website link in chat.

menubackground.name: Menu Background
menubackground.desc: Replaces the main menu panorama with a dark BlackAddons background.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.desc:
Nebula = drifting streaks.
Flow = the slow clouds from the BlackAddons website.
Grid = a grid lit by drifting points.
Ridges = stacked wave lines.
Landscape = a flight over hills toward a setting sun.
Ridges and Landscape are heavy on weaker graphics cards.

menu_fps.name: Menu FPS
menu_fps.desc:
Frame rate of menus without a world.
60 FPS = vanilla's cap.
VSync = your monitor's refresh rate.
Animated backgrounds use more GPU the faster they run.

palette.name: Palette
palette.desc:
Default = the BlackAddons colors.
Theme = follows your UI theme's accent and background.
Custom = your own colors below.

stars.name: Stars
stars.desc: Faint twinkling stars over the nebula.

darken.name: Darken
darken.desc: A black veil over the whole picture, for calmer menus.

animate.name: Animate
animate.desc: Let the nebula drift and the stars twinkle. Off = a still picture.

parallax.name: Parallax
parallax.desc: The picture follows the mouse a little, the stars least.

mainmenu.name: Main Menu
mainmenu.desc: A clean main menu: the main entries in the middle, the rest as icons under them.

singleplayer_in_list.name: Singleplayer in List
singleplayer_in_list.desc: Off = Singleplayer moves to the icon row.

hypixel_button.name: Hypixel Button
hypixel_button.desc: Joins Hypixel straight from the menu.

splash_text.name: Splash Text
splash_text.desc: The yellow line next to the title.

confirm_quit.name: Confirm Quit
confirm_quit.desc: Ask before quitting, in a small card over the quit button.

particlehider.name: Particle Hider
particlehider.desc: Hides world particles to improve visibility and performance.

hide_nearby.name: Hide Nearby
hide_nearby.desc: Hide particles within a close radius from the player.

nearby_radius.name: Nearby Radius
nearby_radius.desc: Distance from the player within which particles are hidden.

hide_far.name: Hide Far
hide_far.desc: Hide particles beyond a maximum distance from the player.

max_distance.name: Max Distance
max_distance.desc: Distance beyond which particles are hidden.

filter_by_particle_type.name: Filter by Type
filter_by_particle_type.desc: Hide specific particle types selected in the picker.

choose_particles.name: Choose Particles
choose_particles.desc: Select which particle types to hide.
choose_particles.label: Select

filter_by_type.name: Filter by Type
filter_by_type.desc: Hide specific particle types selected in the picker.

copyentitydata.name: Copy Entity Data
copyentitydata.desc: Copy the data of the entity you are looking at to the clipboard.

copy_key.name: Copy Key
copy_key.desc: Press while looking at an entity to copy its data.

partydebugger.name: Party Debugger
partydebugger.desc: Show the party as BlackAddons reads it, with the last request and the server's answer.

ask_now.name: Ask Now
ask_now.desc: Send a party request right away, then compare the answer with /p list.
ask_now.label: Ask

locationdebugger.name: Location Debugger
locationdebugger.desc: Draw dungeon location regions in the world and show the current location state.

render_location_walls.name: Render Location Walls
render_location_walls.desc: Fill location regions with half-transparent walls.

copyitemdata.name: Copy Item Data
copyitemdata.desc: Copy the hovered item's data to the clipboard.

copy_key.name: Copy Key
copy_key.desc: Press while hovering an item in a container to copy its data.

devmode.name: Dev Mode
devmode.desc: Developer diagnostics — extra logging, event tracing, exception rethrow.

verbose_logging.name: Verbose Logging
verbose_logging.desc: Emit extra [dev] info-level logs from internal subsystems.

rethrow_listener_exceptions.name: Rethrow Listener Exceptions
rethrow_listener_exceptions.desc: Surface event-listener bugs immediately instead of swallowing them. Forced on automatically in a Fabric dev runtime regardless of this toggle.

log_event_dispatch.name: Log Event Dispatch
log_event_dispatch.desc: Log every EventBus.post — noisy, use only when debugging dispatch.

keytimer.name: Key Timer
keytimer.desc: Shows the remaining auto-pickup window for Wither and Blood Keys.

doorutils.name: Door Utils
doorutils.desc: Box wither and blood doors in the world, colored by whether you hold the key.

box_doors.name: Box Doors
box_doors.desc: Draw 3D boxes on wither/blood doors in the world.

door_box_mode.name: Door Box Mode
door_box_mode.desc: How to render the door boxes.

no_key_color.name: No Key Color
no_key_color.desc: Door box color when you don't have a key.

has_key_color.name: Has Key Color
has_key_color.desc: Door box color when you have a key.

only_next_door_has_key_color.name: Only Next Door Has Key Color
only_next_door_has_key_color.desc: Use the key color only on the next door along the blood rush; other doors keep the no key color.

dungeonmap.name: Dungeon Map
dungeonmap.desc: Renders a live dungeon map HUD during Catacombs runs.

hide_in_boss.name: Hide In Boss
hide_in_boss.desc: Hide the map overlay during boss fights.

boss_peek_keybind.name: Boss Peek Keybind
boss_peek_keybind.desc: Hold to show the map during boss fights.

player_names.name: Player Names
player_names.desc: When to show player names on the map.

custom_marker.name: Custom Marker
custom_marker.desc: Use a custom directional map marker for yourself instead of a player head.

room_prediction.name: Room Prediction
room_prediction.desc: Predict unopened 1x1 room types while using legit map mode.

calculation_method.name: Calculation Method
calculation_method.desc:
Optimistic: live score assumes perfect Speed; its S+ secret goal assumes unfinished puzzles will be completed and uses the projection options below.
Conservative: live score uses elapsed-time Speed; its S+ secret goal keeps unfinished-puzzle penalties and only current detected bonuses.
Both include death penalties.

max_bonus_for_secret_goal.name: Max Bonus For Secret Goal
max_bonus_for_secret_goal.desc: Use the configurable bonus assumptions below when calculating the S+ secret goal.

use_current_crypts.name: Use Current Crypts
use_current_crypts.desc: Use the current Crypt count instead of assuming all 5 Crypt bonus points.

assume_mimic_bonus.name: Assume Mimic Bonus
assume_mimic_bonus.desc: Assume the +2 Mimic bonus will be earned on Floor VI and above.

assume_prince_bonus.name: Assume Prince Bonus
assume_prince_bonus.desc: Assume the +1 Prince bonus will be earned while a Prince room remains possible.

assume_bat_bonus.name: Assume Bat Bonus
assume_bat_bonus.desc: Assume the +1 Bat bonus will be earned before it is detected.

show_needed_secrets.name: Show Needed Secrets
show_needed_secrets.desc: Show the total secrets needed for S+ instead of the remaining amount.

include_paul_in_secret_goal.name: Include Paul In Secret Goal
include_paul_in_secret_goal.desc: Assume Paul's +10 score bonus when calculating the S+ secret goal.

extra_info.name: Extra Info
extra_info.desc: Show additional info below the map.

bonus_style.name: Bonus Style
bonus_style.desc: Style for Mimic, Prince, and Bat bonus indicators.

force_paul.name: Force Paul
force_paul.desc: Always add +10 bonus score for Mayor Paul's EZPZ perk.

force_disable_paul.name: Force Disable Paul
force_disable_paul.desc: Never add Mayor Paul's +10 EZPZ score bonus, even when it is detected.

text_scale.name: Text Scale
text_scale.desc: Scale for room name / secret text on the map.

checkmark_scale.name: Checkmark Scale
checkmark_scale.desc: Scale for checkmark icons on the map.

corner_radius.name: Corner Radius
corner_radius.desc: Corner rounding radius for the map frame.

door_width.name: Door Width
door_width.desc: How wide doors between rooms are drawn on the map.

custom_background_enabled.name: Custom Background
custom_background_enabled.desc: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF behind the map. Choose the file below.

choose_custom_background.name: Background File
choose_custom_background.desc: Choose the PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF to draw behind the map.
choose_custom_background.label: Choose...

background_darkness.name: Background Darkness
background_darkness.desc: Darken the map background without darkening rooms, labels, or player icons.

background_transparency.name: Background Transparency
background_transparency.desc: Make the entire map background, including its darkness, transparent. 100% hides it completely.

checkmark_style.name: Checkmark Style
checkmark_style.desc: What to show over cleared rooms.

center_checkmark.name: Center Checkmark
center_checkmark.desc: Center checkmarks on multi-tile rooms instead of top-left.

hide_unknown_checkmark.name: Hide Unknown Checkmark
hide_unknown_checkmark.desc: Hide the question mark on unopened rooms.

prince_room_icon.name: Prince Room Icon
prince_room_icon.desc: Show a crown on rooms that can contain Prince until he is killed.

limit_room_name_size.name: Limit Room Name Size
limit_room_name_size.desc: Shrink room names to fit within the room's bounds.

head_border.name: Head Border
head_border.desc: Default border color for player heads.

head_direction_indicator.name: Head Direction Indicator
head_direction_indicator.desc: Show a direction indicator on rendered player heads.

class_based_borders.name: Class-Based Borders
class_based_borders.desc: Color head borders by dungeon class.

class_based_names.name: Class-Based Names
class_based_names.desc: Color player names by dungeon class.

debug_logging.name: Debug Logging
debug_logging.desc: Print map packet, calibration, and room scan debug messages to the console.

collect_unknown_room_data.name: Collect Unknown Room Data
collect_unknown_room_data.desc: Record unknown room hashes for future room catalog updates. Disable to stop collecting them.

collect_unknown_room_snapshots.name: Collect Unknown Room Snapshots
collect_unknown_room_snapshots.desc: Save a schematic snapshot when an unknown room is found. These files can be large.

leapmenu.name: Leap Menu
leapmenu.desc: Replaces the Spirit Leap menu with teammate cards showing their view and location, with keybinds and map leaping.

sorting.name: Sorting
sorting.desc: Which teammate goes in which corner, filled left to right, top to bottom.

custom_order.name: Custom Order
custom_order.desc: Player names or classes, top first. A teammate takes the place of their first match.

label.name: Label
label.desc: What each card names: the class, the player, or both.

show_head.name: Show Head
show_head.desc: Draw the teammate's head on their card.

teammate_view.name: Teammate View
teammate_view.desc: Show what each teammate sees on their card. Hidden while a shader pack is in use.

view_fps.name: View FPS
view_fps.desc: How often the hovered card's view is redrawn. The others redraw a few times a second; every redraw renders the world once more.

show_location.name: Show Location
show_location.desc: The room each teammate is in; in the boss, the boss phase, with the section in Floor 7 P3.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Card size. Cards shrink further when they would not fit the screen.

class_colored_cards.name: Class Colored Cards
class_colored_cards.desc: Tint cards with the class color.

tint_dead_players.name: Tint Dead Players
tint_dead_players.desc: Tint the cards of dead teammates red.

show_last_door_opener.name: Show Last Door Opener
show_last_door_opener.desc: Outline the teammate who opened the last Wither door.

left_click_only.name: Left Click Only
left_click_only.desc: Leap only on a left click.

leap_on_release.name: Leap On Release
leap_on_release.desc: Leap when the mouse button is released instead of pressed.

keybind_mode.name: Keybind Mode
keybind_mode.desc:
Corners: one key per corner.
Class: one key per class.

map_leap.name: Map Leap
map_leap.desc: During clear, click a teammate on the dungeon map instead of a card.

after_blood_only.name: After Blood Only
after_blood_only.desc: Keep the cards until the Blood Room is opened.

leap_announce.name: Leap Announce
leap_announce.desc: Tell your party who you leaped to.

hide_players.name: Hide Players
hide_players.desc: Hide teammates standing on you for a moment after you leap.

simonsays.name: Simon Says
simonsays.desc: Highlights the F7/M7 Simon Says device solution in order.

reset_solver.name: Reset Solver
reset_solver.desc: Forget the pattern read so far and start reading the device from scratch — for when it has gone out of step with what is on the wall.
reset_solver.label: Reset

block_wrong_clicks.name: Block Wrong Clicks
block_wrong_clicks.desc: Cancel clicks that aren't on the correct button. Sneak to override.

second_color.name: Second Color
second_color.desc: Highlight of the button after next.

highlight_width.name: Highlight Width
highlight_width.desc: Width of the highlight next to the real button, whatever size its hitbox is enlarged to.

highlight_height.name: Highlight Height
highlight_height.desc: Height of the highlight next to the real button, whatever size its hitbox is enlarged to.

show_while_pattern_plays.name: Show While Pattern Plays
show_while_pattern_plays.desc: Keep the highlights up while the device plays its pattern and the buttons are gone.

ss_break_alert.name: SS Break Alert
ss_break_alert.desc: Announce in party chat when the device resets.

send_restart_chat.name: Send Restart Chat
send_restart_chat.desc: Announce in party chat when the device restarts.

alert_sound.name: Alert Sound
alert_sound.desc: Play a sound when the device breaks.

show_title.name: Show Title
show_title.desc: Show a title when the device breaks / restarts.

print_ss_time_in_chat.name: Print SS Time In Chat
print_ss_time_in_chat.desc: Show how long Simon Says took when a player at the device completes it.

soloclears.name: Solo Clears
soloclears.desc: Records a solo F7/M7 for the BlackAddons leaderboard and hands it in at 300.

board.name: Board
board.desc: Which board to aim at. Skips allowed does not charge for the quiz and ice fill, the way the board scores them; No skips keeps their ten points, because a run that skipped one is ranked among the runs that did.

announce_in_chat.name: Announce In Chat
announce_in_chat.desc: Say in chat when a recording opens, and what the server made of it afterwards.

indicator.name: Indicator
indicator.desc: Show a marker while this mode is on, so the score on screen is never unexplained.

scoreboardtoggle.name: Scoreboard Toggle
scoreboardtoggle.desc: Allows toggling the visibility of the scoreboard sidebar.

show_scoreboard.name: Show Scoreboard
show_scoreboard.desc: Whether the scoreboard sidebar is visible.

toggle_keybind.name: Toggle Keybind
toggle_keybind.desc: Press this key in-world to toggle scoreboard visibility.

fullbright.name: Fullbright
fullbright.desc: Keeps the world fully lit without changing your gamma setting.

disable_light_engine.name: Disable Light Engine
disable_light_engine.desc: Turns the client light engine off while fullbright is on, for more FPS.

customskybox.name: Custom Skybox
customskybox.desc: Replaces the overworld sky with an animated scene in the BlackAddons colors.

style.name: Style
style.desc:
Landscape = the menu's hills, following the time of day.
Synthwave = a striped sun over a neon canyon.
Galaxy = a spiral galaxy over a starry nebula.

palette.name: Palette
palette.desc:
Default = the BlackAddons colors.
Theme = follows your UI theme's accent and background.

adhd.name: ADHD
adhd.desc: Bounces an image around your screen like the DVD logo.

choose_image.name: Image
choose_image.desc: Choose the PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF to bounce around.
choose_image.label: Choose...

size.name: Size
size.desc: Image height as a share of the screen height. The width keeps the image's shape.

transparency.name: Transparency
transparency.desc: Make the image see-through. 100% hides it completely.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: How fast the image moves, in screen heights per second.

count.name: Count
count.desc: How many copies bounce at once, each on its own path.

color_change.name: Color Change
color_change.desc: Tint the image a new color every time it hits a wall. Brightest on light images.

corner_hit.name: Corner Hit
corner_hit.desc: Celebrate when an image hits a corner exactly.

entityqol.name: Entity QoL
entityqol.desc: Quality of life adjustments for entity visuals.

hide_entity_fire.name: Hide Entity Fire
hide_entity_fire.desc: Hides flames rendered around burning entities, including players.

hide_armor.name: Hide Armor
hide_armor.desc: Hides worn armor on players, mobs, and armored animals. Elytra and saddles stay visible.

hide_stuck_arrows_and_stingers.name: Hide Stuck Arrows and Stingers
hide_stuck_arrows_and_stingers.desc: Hides arrows and bee stingers embedded in player models.

quickjoin.name: Quick Join
quickjoin.desc: Join dungeon floors and Kuudra tiers with /f0-/f7, /m1-/m7 and /t1-/t5.

chatcopy.name: Chat Copy
chatcopy.desc: Ctrl-click a chat message to copy it (add Shift to keep formatting codes).

compactchat.name: Compact Chat
compactchat.desc: Stacks repeated chat messages into one line with a counter.

consecutive_only.name: Consecutive Only
consecutive_only.desc: Only stack a message that repeats the newest one.

smoothchat.name: Smooth Chat
smoothchat.desc: Animates chat: messages fade in, the input box slides in, and scrolling is smooth.

fade_in_messages.name: Fade In Messages
fade_in_messages.desc: New messages slide up and fade in.

slide_input_box.name: Slide Input Box
slide_input_box.desc: The input box slides up when chat opens.

smooth_scrolling.name: Smooth Scrolling
smooth_scrolling.desc: Scrolling through chat history glides instead of jumping.

hide_message_indicator.name: Hide Message Indicator
hide_message_indicator.desc: Hides the colored bar at the left of system and unsigned messages.

chathistory.name: Chat History
chathistory.desc: Keeps more chat, keeps it when you disconnect or restart, and remembers what you sent across restarts.

history_length.name: History Length
history_length.desc: Messages kept in chat, and sent messages kept for the up arrow. Vanilla keeps 100.

keep_on_disconnect.name: Keep On Disconnect
keep_on_disconnect.desc: Leaving or switching servers no longer clears the chat.

keep_on_restart.name: Keep On Restart
keep_on_restart.desc: The chat comes back as it was after restarting the game.

save_sent_messages.name: Save Sent Messages
save_sent_messages.desc: Messages and commands you sent stay in the up-arrow history after a restart.

chatmentions.name: Chat Mentions
chatmentions.desc: Highlights chat messages that mention your name or a keyword, with an optional sound.

your_name.name: Your Name
your_name.desc: Messages that mention your username count as mentions.

keywords.name: Keywords
keywords.desc: Extra words or phrases that count as mentions.

highlight_color.name: Highlight Color
highlight_color.desc: Tint drawn behind a message that mentions you.

highlight_word_only.name: Highlight Word Only
highlight_word_only.desc: Tint only the matched name or keyword instead of the whole message.

chatvisualfilters.name: Chat Visual Filters
chatvisualfilters.desc: Hides chat messages that match your patterns.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.desc: Messages matching any of these are hidden. Each pattern has its own match mode and case.

chatnamemenu.name: Chat Name Menu
chatnamemenu.desc: Right-click a chat message to copy it, or a player's message for profile, party, friend and message shortcuts.

chattabs.name: Chat Tabs
chattabs.desc: Tabs above the chat input that show one channel at a time and send to it.

irc_tab.name: IRC Tab
irc_tab.desc: BlackAddons chat shown in game chat.

route_messages.name: Route Messages
route_messages.desc: Typing in a channel tab sends there: party, guild, co-op, or whoever you last messaged privately.

all_tab_ignores_channels.name: All Tab Ignores Channels
all_tab_ignores_channels.desc: Messages that have their own tab don't add to the All tab's unread count.

follow_chat_channel.name: Follow Chat Channel
follow_chat_channel.desc: /chat p, /chat g, /chat coop, /chat b and /chat a also switch the tab.

freezecapture.name: Freeze Capture
freezecapture.desc: Save thread stacks after a 200 ms client stall to config/blackaddons/dev/freezes.

dumpers.name: Dumpers
dumpers.desc: Dump the scoreboard, tab list, action bar, or chat to a file and the clipboard.

dump_scoreboard.name: Dump Scoreboard
dump_scoreboard.desc: Press in-world to dump the sidebar scoreboard.

dump_tab_list.name: Dump Tab List
dump_tab_list.desc: Press to dump the player-list (tab) entries.

dump_action_bar.name: Dump Action Bar
dump_action_bar.desc: Press to dump the last action-bar message.

dump_chat.name: Dump Chat
dump_chat.desc: Press to dump the last few chat messages, spans and hover text included.

tablisttoggle.name: Tab List Toggle
tablisttoggle.desc: Toggles or holds display of player tab list.

toggle_mode.name: Toggle Mode
toggle_mode.desc: If enabled, tapping the player list key toggles the tab list display instead of requiring you to hold it.

toggle_keybind.name: Toggle Keybind
toggle_keybind.desc: Press this key in-world to toggle the tab list display.

save_now.label: Save the current state to disk

reload.label: Reload the config from disk (discards unsaved changes)

reset_settings.label: Reset every setting on every feature

reset_huds.label: Reset every HUD element to its default position and scale

share.label: Copy your whole config - settings, toggles and HUD layout - to share it
share.name: Your config

paste.label: Paste a shared config; every change is shown before it applies

about.title: BlackAddons Reimagined
about.hint: maybe it's worth clicking the names...
about.subtitle: A ground-up rewrite of the original BlackAddons. Every old feature rebuilt rather than ported, a pile of new ones that were never there, and a renderer of our own underneath.
about.credits: Built on BlackSkija · BlackVertex · JetBrains Mono

step.repeat_while_help: Checks before every pass; stops after 10000 passes.
step.block_help: Runs the steps up to its End.
step.if_help: Runs the steps up to its Else or End only when the condition holds. The steps after the End always run.
step.end_help: Closes the nearest Repeat or If above it.
step.stop_steps_help: Stops the rest of these steps. Steps another trigger started go on.
step.waypoint_help: Also removed when you change worlds.
step.missing_help: The addon with this step is not installed. The step keeps its settings and is skipped.
step.else_help: Runs the steps up to the End when the If's condition does not hold.
